Dialogs.Dialog: Morning！ Let's do this today too！
What, what, you want to talk to Rinko？
Okay, the day's just getting started.
Oh, you're still up. Sure, let's talk.
Morning. Let's give it our all today, yeah！
It's already noon. You just got up？
Hey, getting up at this hour？ A nap？
You just got up？ Well, whatever.
Huh, you just got up？ When did you go to bed？
You're going to bed now？ Your schedule's all flipped.
Going to bed already？ That's early.
Night. Guess it's about time to sleep.
Going to bed now？ That's late.
Oh, that reminds me... Ah, never mind.
Hey, is there anything you want to ask me？
Don't stare at me like that... hehe.
▲主人公＊▲. Just wanted to say your name！
You're looking forward to our next date, right？
What's that？ It's a date, you know.
Our last date was nice, huh.
Right, right. Counting on you next time too？
Hmph, so Rinko's the only one who thought so.
Huh？ I'm talking about the present.
Who are you thinking about right now？
Oh really. Because you're SO cool, huh！
Oh really. Because she's SO pretty, huh！
Are you expecting something on Valentine's？
Hehe. Hmm, what should I do...
What are you doing for Christmas？ With your girlfriend, right？
Fine, Rinko will just look forward to it by herself.
Our anniversary's coming up. You remember, right？
Hey, your birthday's coming up, right？ Excited？
I see. That's kind of lonely.
Rinko's birthday's coming up soon～. You remembered, right？
Then I'll go ahead and look forward to it.
This year's almost over, huh. Was it a good year？
The new term's coming up... Can't wait？
I see. Well, you get to be with Rinko, after all.
Spring's almost here. Do you like spring？
Yeah, I want to see the cherry blossoms.
Summer's almost here. Do you like summer？
I see. Beaches, fireworks... Busy, busy.
Yeah, Rinko hates the heat too.
Fall's almost here. Do you like fall？
Well, yeah. Fall for reading, like a library committee member should？
It's kind of a lonely season. But you're not lonely, right？
Winter's almost here. Do you like winter？
Lots of events. And they're for couples, too.
Hey, tell me your favorite color.
Hey, tell me your favorite food.
I see, Rinko too. It's good, right？
Huh, really. Rinko hates it too.
If Rinko were going to wear something, what kind of clothes would you like？
Okay, I'll remember. But don't expect too much.
That's... This is why guys are...
Well, I'll keep it in mind.
Hey, what kind of movies do you like again？
What kind of events at the event hall do you like again？
They do stuff like that？ Huh.
Where do you like going on dates？
I see, Rinko too. Let's go together.
Well, if you like it, okay.
Well, anywhere's fine. As long as you're there.
Hey, if Rinko were an animal, what would she be？
Hehe. I see, a cat. Meow▼
Really？ Hmm, I don't get it.
Hey, what kind of shops do you like again？
Rinko too. Take me there sometime.
There's a place like that？ I don't really get it.
Hehe. I knew, but just checking.
Hey... what do you like about Rinko？
Hey... do you like it？ Um, kissing.
You admitted it. Rinko likes it too, so it's fine！
Hey... do you like physical affection？
Well, Rinko kind of likes it too. Hehe.
Oh really. You're just acting tough.
Hey, when we kiss, don't you worry about people seeing？
Geez, worry a little. Well, whatever.
Hey, we should do lots of stuff together from now on, huh.
With you, Rinko's okay with it.
Do you have a dream for the future？
Huh, make it happen. If Rinko's good enough, she'll help.
I see. Then just follow Rinko's lead.
Hey... could it be Rinko's your first love？
Hehe, yay. Same for Rinko, of course.
Oh, okay. Not that I care！
Hey, do you remember when we first met？
No way, I can't believe you.
Do you remember our first date？
Yeah, I was kind of nervous.
Hey, do you remember when Rinko confessed to you？
Hehe, of course. It was a huge event for you too！
You don't have to ask... I love you, okay？
Yeah, I love you. Um... I'm in love with you.
Let's see. Warm colors, like red or yellow.
I like stores where I can look at clothes.
Cosmetics, maybe. That's fine too, right？
Cute clothes, I guess. That's not weird, right？
Something calm and neat. I wasn't into that before, though.
Casual stuff, after all. Comfortable is best.
We talked a lot today, huh. Hehe.
We talked a fair bit today.
We didn't talk much today. Next time, okay？
Roger. Make sure you wake up.
Wake uuup！ It's time！ Come on, wake up！
Come on, wake up！ You'll be in trouble if you don't, right？ Come on！
Oh, sorry. I forgot to wake you. Hehe.
You're up, you're up. Okay, morning.
Roger. I'll call you when it's time, so leave it to me.
It's tiiime. Um, I'm a little late, but it's fine, right？
Come on, it's time. You know, right？ Hurry up and go.
Hey, don't you have plans？ Meeting someone or something？
Hey, let's play rock-paper-scissors. Best of three, winner gets a reward. How about it？
Hehe, Rinko wins. Now, what should I order you to do... Kidding.
I lost, huh. Then as promised, here's your reward.
On the dot, more or less.
Look outside and you'll see. It's night.
It's the middle of the night！
Rinko Kobayakawa here to tell you it's midnight.
3 a.m. Still not going to bed？
4 a.m. You're really going for it.
8. Shall we get the day going？
9. Time to wake up your brain.
Noon！ Hey, what are you eating？
2. Sleepy... You'd better not fall asleep.
8. What are you up to？ Studying？ Or TV？
10. You're not going to bed yet, right？
One hour left today. Good work.
